blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: For 2-10 years: Chew one (1) gummy daily. For 10+ years: Chew one to two (1-2) gummies daily or as recommended by a healthcare professional. Chew thoroughly before swallowing, under adult supervision.
For the best results, NuBest Omega-3 Gummies should be used alongside a healthy diet, regular exercise, enough sleep and before 11:00 PM.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Water, sugar, glucose syrup (corn syrup), flaxseed oil, citrus pectin, natural orange flavor, beta carotene, citric acid, sodium citrate.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do not exceed the recommended dose. Always consult your healthcare professional before taking this, especially if you are pregnant, and/or breastfeeding, taking medications, or have an existing medical condition. Discontinue use and consult your healthcare professional if any adverse reaction occurs. Remember that you should not take supplements as a substitute for a balanced diet or healthy lifestyle.
This product is not recommended for children under 2 years of age due to risk of choking.
Gummies should be fully chewed under adult supervision.

Keep out of reach of children & pets. Do not use if safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and excessive heat. Gummy colors may change over time due to natural colors. This does not change the potency of the product. Any clouding of bottle is normal.
